Problem (risk): D-296 says an observation is never modified after insert and a correction is retire plus insert plus a link. Seven places in the code run UPDATE on observations, a later ruling says one row updates in place, and the link is not built. No check lists the update sites.
Based on (read): q_max d-296 lines 29-32; UPDATE observations at approvalLedger.ts:910, observationStore.ts:464, awardStore.ts:175, bidChain.ts:213, :304, backfillPackageDates.ts:90, :99 (main 5bbf10e).

options.gain: Records match the code; new updates are caught.
options.how: Name the permitted updates in D-296 and the rules page; add a check that lists the update sites.
